scenarios.scenarioName: Rename a note without losing its attributes

given: Create isolated Project label, a pinned Original project title note with Original project content assigned that label, and an unlabelled regular Rename control note with Unchanged control content through the UI.
when: Open the original note, verify its saved Title and Content, replace them with isolated Renamed project title and Renamed project content, Close and reload. Select Project label, reopen the renamed note and close it, then return to Notes.
then: The old note region is absent; the renamed note exists exactly once in Pinned notes and not Other notes, shows replacement content without Original project content, retains its label and Unpin pressed=true. Rename control retains its content. The label view contains the renamed note once and excludes the unlabelled control; reopened Title and Content contain the new values. Returning to Notes still shows one renamed note and no original note.

findings.explanation: Normalized DOM text may disagree with visible multiline content rendered as adjacent block nodes; clipped screen-reader-only sidebar text can also differ from Playwright text visibility.
findings.resolution: Source semantics retained; no arbitrary CSS fallback or content-internal access added. These representation cases require further independent implementations/probes.

findings.explanation: Empty Trash currently counts nested region roles as note regions; an unspecified auxiliary named region inside Deleted notes could be rejected.
findings.resolution: Do not pretend region role alone uniquely distinguishes arbitrary note/auxiliary objects. Existing explicit note-region contract remains; further public identity disambiguation is needed for such auxiliary layouts.
findings.validation: Static source review; explicitly not closed

findings.explanation: A matching note elsewhere on the page could satisfy a required Trash/Archived collection member while the named collection was empty.
findings.resolution: Bind each positive Trash/Archived result to the existing named collection and exact note identity, retaining content and global uniqueness checks.
findings.validation: Positive in-collection member and matching out-of-collection preview negative contract added.
